verdict_text: YES. The adapter names map correctly to `h.<i>.attn.c_attn.weight`, `scale` is read as `lora_alpha / r = 2`, the delta `B @ A` is transposed under `fan_in_fan_out = true` to `[768, 2304]`, the accumulation is done in float32 and cast back to the base dtype (float32), and all four required checks are asserted before writing. One caveat outside the shown code: the shard layout and index are produced entirely by `save_sharded_safetensors` from the unshown `_ckpt` helper, so clause 4 (100 MiB shard budget, `wte.weight` alone in its own shard, complete `weight_map`) cannot be verified from this artifact alone.
